context: You have a new job as a student assistant at the university career center. Listen to the center's director and repeat what he says.
visual: A bright office with a reception desk, a wall of job advertisements and two small rooms with glass doors for interviews.
sentences: Please greet every visitor at the front desk.
The job board on that wall is updated every Monday morning.
Our advisors can review résumés and help students prepare for interviews.
If a student arrives without an appointment, check whether an advisor is free before sending them away.
The two small rooms with glass doors are reserved for practice interviews and should not be used for meetings.

context: You are training to lead tours of the university's sports stadium. Listen to the tour manager and repeat what she says.
visual: An empty stadium with a green field, rows of blue seats and a large screen above one end of the field.
sentences: Tours begin at the main gate.
Visitors may not walk on the grass.
The stadium was completely renovated three years ago.
It can hold more than forty thousand fans on game days.
The large screen above the field shows replays and messages from our sponsors.
At the end of the tour, guests can visit the locker rooms where the players prepare before each match.
Remind everyone to stay with the group, because some areas of the building are closed to the public for safety reasons.
